purpose: A titled section band for a website page: optional ornament, heading, short rule, then the section's content.
namedChanges: Renamed from `PageShell` to `TitledSection`; the source file is a band (ornament, heading, rule, body), not a page shell.
The default heading level is `h2`, not the source's `h1`; `headingLevel` also allows `h3` (the source allowed only `h1` or `h2`).
The ornament address is the `ornamentSrc` prop, default empty; the source hard-coded `/icon-mark.svg` behind an `ornament` boolean that defaulted to true.
Tailwind is written out as scoped CSS on `--site-block-*` variables; no `@apply`, no `theme()`, no utility classes.

The measured numbers are kept as defaults of props (`rule`, `align`, `maxWidth`, ornament sizes); heading weight is `--site-block-section-title-weight` with fallback 400; the slot wrapper is rendered only when the default slot is given.
